C1035.title: Four 'Insiders' in Xiamen Sentenced for Illegally Stealing Personal Information
C1035.summary: In August 2023, the Siming District Court in Xiamen sentenced a case of infringing citizens' personal information. Defendants Ma, Yang, and Chen jointly hacked a tech company's order-tracking system backend and stole over 70,000 personal information records; Ma and Yang also sold over 40,000 of them. Wang purchased from Ma and resold at a markup, obtaining over 40,000 and selling over 20,000 records. Ma and Yang were each sentenced to 3 years imprisonment with 4 years probation and an 80,000 yuan fine; Wang to 1 year 9 months with 2 years probation and a 50,000 yuan fine; Chen to 1 year 6 months with 2 years probation and a 40,000 yuan fine.

references.title: Xiamen: Four 'Insiders' Sentenced! (Huli Toutiao — official Pengpai account of Xiamen Huli District Party Committee Publicity Department)
